source: Source-informed plain-JavaScript port of upstream React integration. Global, css-prop insertion, cache context and theming closely follow upstream control flow; changed syntax and dependency names do not make these independent implementations. Existing attribution and conformance tests are retained.
changes: Plain-JavaScript port (React.createElement) of the css prop element, JSX runtimes, Global, ClassNames, css, keyframes, cache context and theming.

On vemotion-cache, vemotion-serialize, vemotion-utils, vemotion-weak-memoize and vemotion-use-insertion-effect-with-fallbacks; hoist-non-react-statics (and react-is) is replaced by a small internal function (also the _isolated-hnrs entry).
No macro entry, so no runtime dependency on @emotion/babel-plugin (with babel-plugin-macros, cosmiconfig and @babel/runtime); 5 direct dependencies instead of 8.
Declarations on React's React.JSX namespace (@types/react 18.2.7 and later), checked with React 18.3 and 19 types.
The #is-development and #is-browser conditions choose development or production and browser or server behavior, as in the original's conditional builds.
ES modules with bundled declarations; React is a peer.

verification.upstreamSuite: Complete fixture: React 16 development 413 pass, 2 existing Babel-plugin differences, 8 skipped; React 18 development 416 pass, the same 2 differences, 5 skipped; production 5 pass and 418 skipped.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles a TSX application (css prop through jsxImportSource, Global, ClassNames, theming, keyframes, and two expected errors) against the declarations with DOM and React 18.3 and 19 types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.

implementation.basis: Manual source comparison finds closely retained control flow in Global, element insertion, context and theming. Functional fixes and dependency reductions remain valid but do not establish independent architecture.
implementation.targetScope: VentiMath and MUI cache/theme providers, Global styles, css-prop rendering and ClassNames.
